blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Many questions about a video concern one physical object. Where does the ball end up after the cups are shuffled? Which card is the queen? How often was the mug covered? Video-language models (Video-LMs) recognise such objects in single frames but do not keep them apart over time. On real shell-game videos, open models from 8B to 235B parameters, their thinking variants, a reinforcement-learned tool agent and three training-free tool agents all stay within ten points of chance. We separate semantic identity binding from temporal identity maintenance. An object's identity should be fixed at a moment when the evidence for it is visible, and carried afterwards by a tracker. \emph{Track, Then Bind} implements this principle without training. A promptable video tracker follows every candidate object and draws it with a track number. A frozen vision-language model answers a static question about the identifying evidence, which binds the target to a track. The answer is then derived from the tracked state in text, without asking the model to reinterpret the original video during read-out. A single configuration covers all benchmarks. With Qwen3-VL-32B it solves both VET-Bench tasks, where a fine-tuned trajectory model reaches 92\% and 90\% and the same VLM voting over 16 samples stays at 30--32\%. It answers 55.4\% of the hardest Perception Test cup games, where the best published model answers 41.5\%, and, using track-derived timelines, 48.6\% of TOC-Bench questions, against 37.1\% for the same model answering directly. Drawing the same tracks on the video and asking the question directly falls 12--19 points short of the agent on real cup games.
blocks.zh: 许多关于视频的问题涉及一个物理物体。 杯子洗完后,球到哪里去了? 哪个牌是皇后? 杯子被盖了多久? 视频语言模型(Video-LMs)在单帧中识别此类物体,但不会在一段时间内将它们分开. 在真实的 shell-game 视频中,8B到235B参数的开放模型,他们的思维变体,一个强化学习工具代理和三个无训练工具代理都停留在十点机会之内. 我们把语义性身份绑定 和时间性身份维护分开 物体的身份应在其证据可见的时刻确定,然后由跟踪器携带。 \emph{跟踪, 然后,宾德] 不经过培训就执行这一原则。 一个快速的视频跟踪器跟踪每一个候选对象,并用音轨编号绘制. 一个冷冻的视觉语言模型解答了一个关于识别证据的静态问题,将目标绑在轨道上. 答案随后从文字中的履带状态中衍生出来,而没有要求模型在读出时重新解释原始视频. 单一配置涵盖所有基准。 通过Qune3-VL-32B,它解决了VET-Bench两个任务,一个微调的轨迹模型达到92\%和90\%,同一个VLM对16个样本的投票停留在30-32\%. 它回答了55.4+Q最难的Perception Test杯游戏,其中最佳公布的模型回答了41.5+X,使用音轨衍生的时段,48.6+X TOC-Bench问题,而同一模型直接回答的则是37.1+X. 在视频中绘制同样的音轨,并直接提问,在真杯游戏中比代理差12-19分.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Many questions about a video are questions about one physical object. Which cup hides the ball after the shuffle? Which card is the queen once all three are face down? Is the cap that reappears the one that left? Such questions arise wherever objects are moved, stacked or put away. Examples are assistants that remember where an item was left, robots whose own arm hides the object they manipulate, and laboratory procedures with rows of identical tubes. Answering them requires following one object through occlusion, containment and look-alike copies.
blocks.zh: 许多关于视频的问题都是关于一个物理物体的问题. 洗牌后哪个杯子会隐藏球? 哪个牌是王后 一旦三个都脸朝下? 复现的帽子是留下的吗? 每当物体移动、堆放或收放时,就会产生这些问题。 例如,助手们记得物品留在什么地方,机器人的手臂隐藏着他们操纵的物体,以及用一排相同的管进行实验室程序。 回答它们需要通过封存,封装和类似外观的拷贝跟踪一个物体.

blocks.en: Video-LMs fail at this. On VET-Bench [ 1 ] , the strongest closed models stay at chance on the shell game, and only a model fine-tuned on synthetic trajectories (SGCoT) escapes it. On real cup-game videos from the Perception Test [ 2 ] , the same fine-tuned model returns to chance (Table 1 ). Scale and deliberation do not help: Qwen3-VL at 8B, 32B and 235B answers 27.7–33.8% of the 65 shuffled three-cup videos, and a reinforcement-learned tool agent answers 33.8%. Three training-free tool agents with Qwen3-VL-32B answer 30.8–38.5%. They are SpatialClaw [ 15 ] (code around SAM3 [ 44 ] ), VideoAgent [ 7 ] (a tracking-based object memory) and VideoINSTA [ 8 ] (captioned event clips). On TOC-Bench [ 3 ] , the 32B thinking variant performs nearly the same as the direct 32B model (36.9% versus 37.1%).
blocks.zh: 视频LM失败了 在VET-Bench [1]上,最强的闭合模型在壳牌游戏上偶然停留,只有对合成轨迹(SGCoT)进行微调的模型才能逃脱. 在来自Perception测试[2]的真杯游戏视频上,同一微调模型回归机会(表1). Qwen3-VL at 8B, 32B和235B 回答65个洗牌三杯视频的27.7-33.8%, 强化学习工具代理回答33.8%. 3个无训练工具代理 Qwen3-VL-32B答 30.8–38.5%. 它们是SpaceClaw [15](SAM3[44]周围的代码),VideoAgent [7](一个基于跟踪的物体内存)和VideoINSTA [8](封装事件片段). 在TOC-Bench[3]上,32B思维变体的性能与直接32B模式几乎相同(36.9%对37.1%).

blocks.en: A central difficulty is that the model must re-derive which object is which from a sparse sample of frames. Identical objects that cross or disappear leave almost no visual trace from which to do so. A promptable video tracker such as SAM2 [ 4 ] has the opposite strengths. It follows each object mask through motion and brief occlusion, but it does not know which object a question refers to. We study two design choices in combining them. When should the system ask the VLM about an object’s identity? A hidden ball can only be recognised before it is hidden, a card only while it is face up. And once the identity is fixed, what should decide the answer: the VLM’s reading of the video, or the tracked state?
blocks.zh: 一个核心的难题是,模型必须重新定型哪一个物体是从一个稀疏的帧样本中选择的。 交叉或消失的同样物体几乎没有留下任何视觉痕迹。 SAM2[4]等快速视频跟踪器具有相反的优点. 它通过运动和短暂的隔离来跟踪每个物体的面具,但是它不知道一个问题指的是哪个物体. 我们研究两个设计选择 结合它们。 系统何时应该向 VLM 询问对象的身份 ? 隐藏的球只有在隐藏之前才能被识别出来,卡片只有在面对时才能被识别出来. 一旦身份被确定,应该由什么来决定答案:VLM读取视频,或者跟踪状态?

blocks.en: We answer them with two design rules and test each in isolation. First, the VLM is asked about an object’s identity only through a static question about the moment at which the identity can be seen. A tracker then carries the identity, and the VLM is not asked again. Second, once the target is bound, the answer is read from the tracked state as text, without showing the video again. Track, Then Bind (Fig. 1 ) implements both rules without training. Every candidate carries a track number on the clip that the VLM sees, so its answer binds the target to one track. A plan made by the VLM decides which objects to follow and how the target can be recognised. As an extension to visibility and event questions that need no identity binding, the same framework supplies a timeline built from the tracks. One program and one set of thresholds serve all benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个设计规则回答它们,并且各自单独测试。 首先,VLM只通过一个静态问题来询问一个物体的身份,即该身份何时可以被看到. 追踪器随即携带身份, VLM 不再被询问. 第二,一旦目标被绑定,答案从履带状态读作文字,而不再次显示视频. 轨迹 然后宾德(图1)不经过训练就执行这两项规则. 每个候选者在VLM看到的片段上都带有音轨编号,因此其答案将目标绑在一个音轨上. VLM制定的计划决定了哪些反对和如何识别目标. 同样的框架还提供了从铁轨上建立的时间表,以扩展至不需要身份约束的能见度和事件问题。 一个方案和一套阈值适用于所有基准。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • A diagnosis across model families. On shuffled real cup games, closed and open Video-LMs, thinking variants, a trajectory-fine-tuned model, a reinforcement-learned tool agent and three training-free tool agents all stay within ten points of chance. Voting over 16 samples of Qwen3-VL leaves VET-Bench at 28–32%. • Binding through a static question about the identifying moment. With the tracks held fixed, asking which cup the target is under right after it is hidden, instead of where it is at the end, raises development cup-game accuracy by 8.7 points at 8B and 8.2 points at 32B (Appendix E ). Drawing the same tracks on the video and asking the question directly stays at 32.7–44.0% at 8B, against 51.4–100% for the agent, and 12.1 points below the agent on real cup games at 32B. • Answering from the tracked state. Given the same correct facts together with the shuffled video, the VLM follows its own reading of the video. The synthetic cup game drops from 100% to 38.0% at 8B and to 76.0% at 32B, and real cup games drop by 3.7–4.7 points. • One configuration across benchmarks. The agent is tuned once on development videos of all benchmarks. At 32B it improves the direct answer by 16.8 points on real cup games and by 11.5 points on TOC-Bench. It matches agents tuned separately for each benchmark and issues about half their model calls on TOC-Bench.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: 在洗牌的真正的杯子游戏中,闭锁和开放的视频LM,思维变体,一个轨迹精细的调整模型,一个强化学习工具代理和三个无训练工具代理都停留在十点机会之内. 投票超过16个Qwen3-VL样本,VET-Bench为28-32%. • 通过一个静态的关于确定身份的时刻的问题进行约束。 在固定的音轨下,询问目标藏好后正下方的哪个杯子,而不是末端的位置,使8B的开发杯游戏精度提高了8.7分,32B的8.2分(附录E. 在视频上绘制相同的音轨并直接提问,在8B时保持32.7–44.0%,代理商则保持51.4–100%,在32B时真实的杯子游戏上则停留在代理商以下12.1分。 ^ 由跟踪状态回答. 鉴于同样正确的事实以及被洗劫的视频,VLM沿用自己对视频的阅读. 合成杯游戏在8B时从100%降至38.0%,在32B时降至76.0%,真正的杯游戏则下降了3.7–4.7分. ^ 一个跨基准的配置。 该代理机一次调用所有基准的发展视频. 在32B时,它改进了真杯赛的直答16.8分,TOC-Bench的直答11.5分. 它与每个基准分别调整的代理匹配,并发布大约一半的模型呼吁TOC-Bench.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Video-LMs and their temporal limits. Video-LMs pair a visual encoder with a language model and are tuned on video instructions [ 24 , 23 , 22 ] . Current open families such as Qwen2.5-VL [ 20 ] , InternVL3 [ 21 ] , Qwen3-VL [ 17 ] and Molmo2 [ 18 ] add dynamic frame rates, timestamps and grounding outputs. Benchmarks that isolate time find that much of their accuracy comes from single frames. MVBench [ 25 ] and NExT-QA [ 26 ] probe temporal and causal actions, EgoSchema [ 27 ] and Video-MME [ 19 ] long videos, TempCompass [ 28 ] finds that many models barely exceed chance once single-frame and language shortcuts are removed, and TOMATO [ 29 ] measures a 57-point gap to humans on questions that need the frame order. VELOCITI [ 30 ] finds weak binding of agents to actions across events, and VSI-Bench [ 31 ] limited visual-spatial reasoning. VET-Bench [ 1 ] and TOC-Bench [ 3 ] target object identity directly, the setting of this paper.
blocks.zh: 视频LM及其时间限制. 视频 LMs将一个视觉编码器与语言模型配对,并按视频指令[24,23,22]调谐. 目前开放的家庭如Quen2.5-VL[20],InternVL3[21],Quen3-VL[17]和Molmo2[18]增加了动态帧率,时间戳和地面输出. 孤立时间的基准发现其精确度大多来自单帧. MV Bench [25]和NExT-QA [26] 探测时间和因果行动,EgoSchema [27]和Video-MME [19] 长视频,TempCompass [28] 发现许多模型在单帧和语言快捷键被移除后几乎不超过机会,TOMATO [29] 在需要帧顺序的问题上测量人类57点的差距. VELOCITI [30] 发现代理人对跨事件行动的约束薄弱,VSI-Bench [31] 视觉空间推理有限. VET-Bench [1]和TOC-Bench [3] 目标对象身份直接,本文的设置.

blocks.en: Reasoning-enhanced Video-LMs. Chain-of-thought prompting [ 32 ] and its video variants [ 33 ] write intermediate steps before the answer, and self-consistency [ 34 ] votes over sampled chains. On VSI-Bench neither improves spatial answers [ 31 ] . Reinforcement-learned models such as Video-R1 [ 35 ] and Open-o3-Video-v2 [ 5 ] add textual or grounded reasoning traces. SGCoT [ 1 ] fine-tunes Molmo2 to write object trajectories before answering, and RGA3 [ 6 ] trains a Video-LLM to refer to and ground objects with spatio-temporal prompts. In all of these, identity is held in learned representations or generated tokens, which our diagnosis shows is not enough for look-alike and hidden objects. We use self-consistency as a call-matched baseline (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 理由增强 Video-LMs. 思维链激发 [32] 及其视频变体 [33] 在回答前写出中间步骤,和自我一致 [34] 投票比被抽样的链条. 在VSI-Bench上,都没有改进空间答案[31]. 视频-R1[35]和Open-o3-Video-v2[5]等强化学习模型添加文字或基于推理痕迹. SGCoT [1] 微调 Molmo2 以在回答前写入对象轨迹,RGA3 [6] 训练一个视频-LLM 以spatio-时速提示来引用和地面对象. 在所有这些中,身份都存在于学习到的表示或生成的符物中,我们的诊断表明,这不足以表示外观和隐藏的物体。 我们使用自我一致性作为呼叫匹配的基准(表3)。

blocks.en: Object permanence. Infants expect a hidden object to persist [ 36 ] and parse scenes into cohesive bodies that move continuously [ 37 ] . In vision, CATER [ 38 ] and CLEVRER [ 39 ] test these abilities on synthetic videos with containment and collisions. Learned models localise contained and carried objects [ 40 ] , keep tracks through full occlusion [ 41 ] , learn intuitive physics from object-centric codes [ 42 ] , and segment objects inside containers [ 16 ] . Xie and Alanwar [ 68 ] find that video world models keep visible objects but drop hidden ones. We use a frozen tracker and VLM to maintain explicit identity associations across occlusion and containment.
blocks.zh: 对象永久 。 婴儿们期望隐藏的物体会持续[36],并将场景剖析成连续运动的凝聚体[37]. 在视觉中,CATER [38] 和CLEVRER [39] 在带有封装和碰撞的合成视频上测试这些能力. 所学的模型定位和携带的物体[40],通过完全隐蔽来保持跟踪[41],从以物体为中心的编码中学习直观物理学[42],以及容器内的片段物体[16]。 谢和艾伦瓦尔[68]发现视频世界模型保留了可见的物体,但放下隐藏的物体. 我们使用冷冻追踪器和VLM 来保持明确的身份联系 覆盖和封存。

blocks.en: Segmentation and tracking. Promptable segmentation [ 43 ] extends to video with a streaming memory in SAM2 [ 4 ] and to concept prompts in SAM3 [ 44 ] . Memory-based video object segmentation [ 45 , 46 ] , point tracking [ 47 ] and tracking-by-detection [ 48 ] keep identities through motion and short occlusion, and open-vocabulary detectors [ 49 ] supply the initial boxes. None of them knows which object a question refers to. Our agent obtains the boxes from the VLM and the identities from SAM2.1.
blocks.zh: 分离和跟踪。 快速分解 [43] 扩展至SAM2中带有流传内存的视频 [4] 扩展至SAM3中的概念提示 [44]. 基于内存的视频物体分割[45,46],点跟踪[47]和逐项跟踪[48]通过运动和短封装保存身份,开放的伏车探测器[49]提供初始箱. 没有一个知道问题指的是什么 我们的特工从VLM和SAM2.1那里得到箱子

blocks.en: Visual prompting with tracks. Marks drawn on an image steer a model to a region: a red circle for CLIP [ 50 ] , numbered regions in Set-of-Mark [ 10 ] , and free-form prompts learned by ViP-LLaVA [ 51 ] . Coarse Correspondences [ 11 ] draws tracker IDs on video frames and lets the model answer the whole question. Elysium [ 52 ] , VideoRefer [ 53 ] and Sa2VA [ 54 ] instead train Video-LLMs to track, refer to or segment objects. We draw the same kind of numbered tracks, but the model only answers a static question about one moment, and the answer comes from the tracks. Section 5.3 shows that the overlay alone recovers little of the gain at 8B and part of it at 32B.

blocks.en: Tool-using agents. VisProg [ 55 ] and ViperGPT [ 56 ] compose vision modules through generated programs, and ReAct [ 57 ] interleaves reasoning with tool calls. For video, agents retrieve frames iteratively [ 58 ] , summarise clip captions [ 59 , 8 ] , plan over a symbolic memory [ 60 ] , or store object-centric tracking states that an LLM queries [ 7 ] . STRAND [ 9 ] links per-chunk object states by attribute and position similarity, making identical objects difficult to separate. SpatialClaw [ 15 ] writes code that calls SAM3 and Depth Anything 3 [ 61 ] . AgentRVOS [ 12 ] reasons over SAM3 tracks to segment a referred, visible object, and Dual-Agent [ 13 ] and ACTrack [ 14 ] use a VLM to verify or re-prompt a tracker. These agents, like ours, keep object state outside the model, and they leave the final judgement of which object is which to the model. Our design differs in when the model is asked about identity and in what decides the answer once identity is fixed.

STRAND [9] 按属性和位置相似度将每个圆柱形对象的链接表示,使相同的对象难以分离. SpaceClaw [15] 写下代码,称SAM3和深度 Anything 3 [61]. AgentRVOS [12] 理由在 SAM3 轨迹上分出一个被提及,可见的对象,双代理 [13] 和 ACTRack [14] 使用一个 VLM来验证或重制一个跟踪器. 这些特工和我们的一样,将对象状态保留在模型之外,他们将最终判断哪个对象留给模型. 我们的设计不同,当问到模型关于身份的问题时,以及在确定身份后如何决定答案时。

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: Track, Then Bind organises inference into five steps (Fig. 2 ; Algorithm 1 in Appendix A ). A plan decides which steps run, and all thresholds are the same for every benchmark.
blocks.zh: Track,然后宾德组织推论为五个步骤(图2;附录A中的算法1). 计划决定哪个步骤运行,每个基准的所有阈值都是相同的.

blocks.en: Step 1: Plan. The VLM watches V V at 2 fps and fills a fixed schema. It lists the entities in q q with their roles: the target, its carriers, and other subjects . It states how the target is recognised, by its look or as hidden in a carrier, and whose left and right the question uses. A separate text-only question asks whether q q is about the target’s final location. If the target is recognised by its look and no carrier is named, all objects of the target’s category become its carriers. The plan selects these operations from the question using the same schema across benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 步骤1:计划。 VLM在2英尺处观察VV,并填充固定的图案. 它列出了qq中的各个实体及其作用:目标、其载体和其他主体。 它说明了如何通过外观或隐藏在载体中来识别目标,以及问题的左右用法。 一个单独的文本问题询问q q是否与目标最终位置有关. 如果目标因其外观而得到承认,而且没有指明载体,则目标类别的所有物体都成为其载体。 计划使用同样的跨基准计划从问题中选择这些操作.

blocks.en: Step 2: Perceive. The VLM boxes all entities in one call per frame, on 8 frames spaced evenly over the video. Entities found on none of these frames receive a second round of 8 frames in between. SAM2.1 [ 4 ] is prompted on the earliest frame that shows the most common number of instances, or on the largest box for a single object. It propagates every instance forward and backward at 6 fps. Carrier tracks that overlap, move more than a quarter of their width per frame, or end early trigger a second pass. This pass tracks the carriers and the target at the native frame rate, up to 300 frames. Tracking all candidates jointly separates identical objects by their trajectories, and the dense pass is spent only where they cross. All questions about one video share its boxes and tracks.

blocks.en: Step 3: Find evidence moments. The bind question of step 4 always names the moment it is about: the target in view, or the target right after it is hidden. Step 3 tries to locate that moment t e t_{e} in the tracks, so that the VLM sees a short clip (Eq. 3 ). For a target recognised by its look, the moments are the frames on which the VLM found it in step 2. A mask track alone cannot tell a face-up card from its back. For a hidden target, the moment is its last view before its own track vanishes inside the frame. Small hidden objects are often lost by the tracker or never vanish cleanly. In that case no moment is located, and the clip covers the whole video. The VLM then finds the moment named by the question itself. Section 5.3 reports how often each case occurs (Table 6 ) and when a located moment matters (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 步骤3:寻找证据时刻。 第4步的束缚性问题总是在它所涉及的时刻点名:在视线内的目标,或者在它被隐藏之后的目标. 步骤3试图在轨迹中定位该瞬间 t e t_{e},以便VLM看到一个短片段(Eq. 3 ). 对于其外观所识别的目标来说,瞬间是VLM发现它步入的帧. 2. 单凭面具追踪无法从背后分辨出面孔卡。 对于一个隐藏的目标来说,此时此刻是它自己的轨迹消失在帧内之前的最后一景. 小型隐藏的物体常常被追踪器丢失,或者永远没有干净的消失. 在这种情况下,没有找到任何时间,片段覆盖了整个视频. 然后,VLM发现了问题本身所命名的时刻. 第5.3节报告每个案件发生频率(表6)和何时发生某一时间事项(表5)。

blocks.en: Step 4: Bind. Each carrier track is drawn as a numbered box on a 4 fps clip, with at most 96 frames. The clip spans 3 s around a located moment ( δ = 1.5 \delta=1.5 s), or the whole video. The VLM answers one static question q b q_{\mathrm{b}} and returns k ⋆ k^{\star} . For a target recognised by its look it names the numbered carrier that is the target. For a hidden target it names the carrier the target is under right after it is hidden. When several moments exist, the last one with a valid number decides. The question concerns a single moment, not the history after it, so the VLM never has to follow the target through the shuffle.
blocks.zh: 步骤4:捆绑。 每个载体轨迹在4fps剪辑上作为编号框绘制,最多96帧. 片段跨度为3秒左右的定位瞬间( =1.5\delta=1.5s),或整个视频. VLM 回答一个静态的问题 q b q mathrm{ b}} , 并返回 k k  star} 。 对于其外观所识别的目标,它命名为编号载体,即目标。 对于隐藏的目标,它命名载体 目标就在它隐藏之后。 当存在数个瞬间时,最后一个有有效数字的瞬间决定. 问题只涉及一个瞬间,而不是它之后的历史,因此VLM从不必通过洗牌来跟踪目标.

blocks.en: Step 5: Read out. A bound target is answered from facts. The agent states them in plain words, for example “the hidden object was hidden under mug #2 … so the hidden object is under the first mug from the camera’s left”. If q q uses a person’s point of view, one more VLM call on four frames asks whether that person is opposite the camera. The facts then also give the person’s left-to-right position. These facts are ℱ \mathcal{F} in Eq. 4 . The VLM answers q q from them alone, without the video, making the tracked facts the evidence for read-out. Questions without a bound target use the timeline ℒ \mathcal{L} of Eq. 5 . Per-subject visibility segments, an ordered list of events and the coarse direction of motion are appended to the benchmark’s prompt. The VLM then answers with the benchmark’s own frames, template and parser. An answer that cannot be parsed falls back to the direct answer.

VLM只从他们身上回答q q,没有视频,使跟踪的事实成为读出的证据. 无约束目标的问题使用 Eq. 5 的时间表 L\ mathcal{L} 。 每个主题的能见度部分、有序的事件清单和粗糙的运动方向附在基准的提示之后。 VLM 然后用基准自己的框架、模板和解析器回答。 无法解析的答案会回到直接答案。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate on three benchmarks that ask about object identity. VET-Bench [ 1 ] contains 50 synthetic shell-game videos ( cup ) and 50 card-monte videos ( card ). The Perception Test [ 2 ] cup-game subset ( PT ) has 107 real test videos. The VET-Bench authors filtered it to remove single-frame shortcuts. Following them, we also report its 65 videos with three cups and at least one swap ( PT-65 ). TOC-Bench [ 3 ] asks about object consistency in real videos along ten dimensions, such as event counts, durations and reappearance. Accuracy is scored with each benchmark’s own answer parser.
blocks.zh: 基准。 我们用三个标准来评估 询问物体身份 VET-Bench [1] 包含50个合成贝壳游戏视频(杯)和50个卡蒙视频(卡). 感知测试[2]杯游戏子集(PT)有107个真正的测试视频. VET-Bench作者对其进行过滤以删除单帧快捷键. 之后,我们报告65个视频,其中3个杯子,至少1个互换(PT-65)。 TOC-Bench [3] 询问真实视频中围绕十维的物体一致性,如事件计数,持续时间和重现. 准确性与每个基准本身的答案解析器一致。

blocks.en: Development and test data. Design choices and thresholds are selected on development data. These are 195 cup-game videos from the Perception Test validation split, 56 card-monte videos rendered with the VET-Bench generator, and 478 TOC-Bench questions. We split the 2,323 TOC-Bench questions by video into these 478 development questions and 1,845 test questions. The configuration is frozen and then run once on the test sets. Each ablation on the test sets changes one step of the frozen configuration.
blocks.zh: 开发和测试数据。 在开发数据上选择设计选择和阈值。 这些是来自Perception测试验证拆分的195个杯式游戏视频,56个卡蒙视频与VET-Bench生成器一起提供,以及478个TOC-Bench问题. 我们通过视频将2,323个TOC-Bench问题分成这478个发展问题和1,845个测试问题。 配置被冻结,然后在测试集上运行一次. 测试机上的每一节节奏都会改变冷冻配置的一步.

blocks.en: Baselines. Open Video-LMs answer directly with each benchmark’s prompt, frames and parser. We run them in vLLM [ 67 ] . The footnote of Table 1 also gives Qwen3-VL answering in Hugging Face Transformers, the engine of our agent. The reasoning-enhanced baselines are the Qwen3-VL thinking variants and two trained models. Molmo2-SGCoT [ 1 ] is fine-tuned to write object trajectories before it answers. Open-o3-Video-v2 [ 5 ] is trained with reinforcement learning to crop and inspect frames. We run the official code of two training-free agents with Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct, the backbone of our 32B agent. SpatialClaw [ 15 ] writes Python code calling SAM3 [ 44 ] and Depth Anything 3 [ 61 ] . VideoAgent [ 7 ] builds an object memory from a detector, a tracker and re-identification, and queries it with an LLM. Section 5.2 adds call-matched and increased-input baselines, and Appendix C lists all settings.
blocks.zh: 基线。 打开视频 LM 直接回答每个基准的快捷、帧和解析器 。 我们运行在vLLM [67]。 表1的脚注还给出了Qwen3-VL在Hugging Face Transformers,即我们代理商的引擎中的响应. 推理增强的基线是Qwen3-VL思维变体和两个训练有素的模型. Mollmo2-SGCoT [1] 微调后在解答前写出对象轨迹. Open-o3-Video-v2 [5]通过强化学习来进行收割和检查帧的培训. 我们运行两个无训练特工的官方代码 与Quen3 -VL -32B -Instruct, 我们32B特工的骨干。 SpaceClaw [15] 写着 Python 代码,叫 SAM3 [44] 和深度 Anything 3 [61]. VideoAgent [7] 从一个探测器,一个跟踪器和重新识别中构建一个对象内存,并用一个LLM进行查询. 第5.2节增加了调用和增加投入的基准,附录C列出了所有设置。

blocks.en: Implementation details. The VLM is Qwen3-VL-8B- or 32B-Instruct [ 17 ] with greedy decoding, and the tracker is SAM2.1-hiera-large [ 4 ] . A timeline marks an object as fully visible when its mask covers at least 0.6 of its 90th-percentile area, and as partly hidden down to 0.12 of it. Segments shorter than 0.5 s are merged. A disappearance counts as leaving the frame if the last box lies within 2% of the border. All prompts are listed in Appendix H . Paired comparisons report item-level bootstrap 95% confidence intervals (CI) and exact McNemar tests.
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 VLM是Qwen3-VL-8B-或32B-指令[17] 贪婪的解码,追踪器是SAM2.1-hiera-大[4]. 当一个物体的面具覆盖至少0.6个90百分位面积时,一个时间线就标记为完全可见的物体,并且部分隐藏在其中0.12. 短于0.5s的片段被合并. 如果最后一个盒子位于边界的2%以内,失踪即算离框。 所有提示列于附录H。 Paired比较报告物品级的靴子 95%的置信间隔(CI)和精确的McNemar测试.

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Comparison with existing methods. Table 1 compares Track, Then Bind with direct answers, reasoning-enhanced models and tool agents. On VET-Bench, the only prior method above chance is SGCoT, which is fine-tuned on synthetic trajectories and reaches 92.0% and 90.0%. Our agent solves both tasks with both backbones and without training. On the 107 real cup games, SGCoT falls back to 32.7%. The agent reaches 51.4% at 8B and 52.3% at 32B. That is 17.8 (CI [3.7, 30.8]) and 16.8 points (CI [3.7, 29.9]) above the same models answering directly. The shuffled three-cup subset separates the methods most clearly. Every baseline stays within ten points of chance on it, and the 32B agent reaches 55.4%. On TOC-Bench the agent reaches 43.0% at 8B and 48.6% at 32B, 17.9 (CI [15.4, 20.4]) and 11.5 points (CI [9.0, 14.0]) above the direct answers. The 32B agent is also 11.7 points above the 32B thinking variant and 14.7 points above Open-o3-Video-v2. GPT-5.5 reaches 47.1% on the full question set.
blocks.zh: 与现有方法的比较。 表1 比较 轨迹 然后用直接的答案,推理增强的模型和工具代理来捆绑. 在VET-Bench上,唯一比机会更高的前置方法是SGCoT,它在合成轨迹上进行了微调,达到92.0%和90.0%. 我们的特工既用骨干又不用训练就能完成两个任务. 在107场真正的杯赛上,SGCoT跌回32.7%. 该剂在8B时达到51.4%,在32B时达到52.3%. 即17.8(CI [3.7, 30.8])和16.8点(CI [3.7, 29.9])以上相同的模型直接回答. 洗牌的三杯子集将方法区分得最清楚. 每个基线都停留在10个机会点之内,32B剂达到55.4%. 在TOC-Bench上,该剂在8B时达到43.0%,在32B时达到48.6%,在直接答复上方达到17.9(CI [15.4,20.4])和11.5分(CI [9.0,14.0]). 32B剂也比32B思维变体高11.7分,比Open-o3-Video-v2. GPT-5.5在全题组上达到47.1%.

blocks.en: Comparison with tool-using agents. Three training-free agents run with our 32B backbone. SpatialClaw [ 15 ] writes code that calls SAM3 and judges the answer from the images. VideoAgent [ 7 ] queries an object memory built by a detector, a tracker and re-identification. VideoINSTA [ 8 ] reasons over captions and object lists of event clips. All three stay within ten points of chance on the cup games and below the direct answer on TOC-Bench. Our 32B agent is 10.3–72.0 points higher on every set (Appendix D ). Only the 10.3-point gap to VideoINSTA on real cup games is not significant. The tools alone do not carry identity. SpatialClaw propagates masks through only a quarter of the VET-Bench videos, VideoAgent’s detector misses playing cards, and VideoINSTA keeps no object track.
blocks.zh: 与工具使用代理比较. 三名无训练特务以32B骨干运行. SpaceClaw [15] 写代码,称SAM3,并判断图像的答案. VideoAgent [7] 查询由探测器,跟踪器和重新识别所构建的对象内存. VideoINSTA [8] 标题和事件剪辑对象列表上的原因. 三者在杯赛上都停留在10个机会点内,在TOC-Bench上直接回答以下. 我们的32B代理在每个集上都高出10.3–72.0分(附录D). 在真实的杯子游戏上,只有10.3点与VideoINSTA的差距并不显著. 仅这些工具无法携带身份。 SpaceClaw只透过四分之一的VET-Bench视频传播口罩,

Self-consistency [ 34 ] : k k answers sampled at the model’s recommended temperature and a majority vote, with k k the agent’s mean number of VLM calls on that benchmark (at most 16). More input tokens : one answer from 16 fps and larger frames. SpatialClaw : as in Table 1 . Calls: VLM calls per question on cup/card/PT/TOC. Tokens: VLM input tokens per PT question.

blocks.en: TOC-Bench by dimension. The agent improves the direct answer in nine of ten dimensions at 8B and in eight at 32B (Table 2 ). The largest gains, 21–34 points, are in event existence, reappearance versus disappearance, and relative spatial change. A visibility timeline answers these questions almost directly. Conditional-state questions ask about one object at an event of another. On them the 32B agent drops from 49.8% to 44.7%.
blocks.zh: TOC-Bench按维度。 该剂在8B的10个维度中的9个和32B的8个维度中改进了直接答案(表2 )。 最大的收益,21-34点,是偶然存在、重新出现与消失以及相对空间变化。 一个能见度时间表几乎直接回答了这些问题. 条件状态问题在另一个事件时询问一个物体。 在他们身上,32B剂从49.8%下降到44.7%。

blocks.en: Comparison with larger inference budgets. The agent issues 11–19 VLM calls and 7–27k input tokens per question (Appendix A breaks down the cost), while a direct answer issues one call. Table 3 increases the direct answer’s call or input budget. Self-consistency samples as many answers as the agent makes calls and takes the majority vote. The second baseline increases input tokens in a single answer, with 16 fps and larger frames. On VET-Bench the voted answers stay at 28–32%. After the shuffle no frame shows where the target is, so more samples of the same frames add no evidence. On the real cup games, the 8B vote over 13 samples reaches 46.7%, against 33.6% for a single answer. The agent is 4.7 points higher (CI [ − 9.3 -9.3 , 18.7]) and reads one sixth of the input tokens (25k against 157k). At 32B the vote reaches 37.4%, and the agent is 15.0 points higher (CI [2.8, 27.1]). On TOC-Bench the vote changes the direct answer by less than one point at both sizes. A single answer with more input tokens reads 34k tokens per cup game, and its accuracy falls below that of the plain direct answer. SpatialClaw spends the largest budget, about 19 times the agent’s input tokens per real cup game.
blocks.zh: 与较大的推论预算进行比较。 代理机每问题发出11–19 VLM呼叫和7–27k输入符(附录A细分成本),而直接回答则发出一个呼叫. 表3增加了直接答复或投入预算。 自我一致抽样的答案与代理商的通话和多数票数一样多. 第二个基线在一个单个答案中增加输入符,有16个fps和更大的帧. VET-Bench的投票答案维持在28-32%。 在洗牌后,没有帧显示目标位置,所以更多相同帧的样本会增加任何证据. 在真正的杯赛上,8B对13个样本的投票率达到46.7%,而单次答题的投票率为33.6%. 剂高4.7分(CI[−9.3-9.3,18.7]),读取输入符的六分之一(25k对157k). 在32B时,投票率达到37.4%,代理人的得分更高15.0分(CI [2.8,27.1]). 在TOC-Bench上,投票将直接回答在两种大小上都改变不到1分. 使用更多输入符的单答每杯游戏读作34k令牌,其准确度低于普通直答. 空间 Claw花费的预算最多,每场真正的杯赛大约是代理商输入符的19倍.

blocks.en: Table 4 : General video questions (accuracy, %, Qwen3-VL-8B). Top: 2,000 Perception Test validation questions, stratified by area and type of reasoning. Bottom: Video-MME, short and medium videos. The direct answer is run in the same engine and the same pass as the agent.
blocks.zh: 表4:一般视频问题(准确度,%,Quen3-VL-8B). 顶部:2000度 测试验证问题,按地区和推理类型进行分级. 底部:视频-MME,短视频和中视频. 直接的回答在同一个引擎中运行,和代理机一样通过.

blocks.en: General video questions. Table 4 tests the agent on questions that are not about object identity. We sample 2,000 questions from the Perception Test validation split, stratified by area and type of reasoning, and exclude the development videos. The agent answers 71.5% of them and the direct answer 69.3% ( + 2.1 +2.1 , CI [0.5, 3.7], p = 0.011 p{=}0.011 ). The gain is largest on physics and memory questions, and semantic questions are unchanged. On 1,800 short and medium Video-MME [ 19 ] questions, the agent answers 70.9% and the direct answer 71.9% ( − 1.0 -1.0 , CI [ − 2.1 -2.1 , 0.1], p = 0.09 p{=}0.09 ). These questions rarely concern a single object. The plan binds none of them, and the appended timeline adds little information.
blocks.zh: 一般视频问题. 表4测试了与物体身份无关的问题。 我们从Perception测试的验证中抽取了2000个问题,按地区和推理类型分解,排除了开发视频. 代理人回答其中71.5%,直接回答69.3%(+2.1+2.1,CI [0.5,3.7],p = 0.011 p = 0.011). 增益在物理和记忆问题上最大,语义问题不变. 在1800个中短视频-MME [19]问题上,代理回答70.9%,直接回答71.9%(−1.0-1.0,CI [−2.1-2.1,0.1],p=0.09 p{=}0.09). 这些问题很少涉及一个单一的目标。 计划对其中任何一项都没有约束力,所附时间表增加了很少的信息。

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.3 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 5 : Ablation of the three steps (test sets, accuracy %). Each variant keeps the agent’s plan, boxes and tracks and changes one step. Tracks drawn, question asked directly : the numbered clip of the whole video with the benchmark question, as in visual prompting with tracker IDs. Bind question on the whole video : no located moment. Facts read out with the video : the same facts are appended to the benchmark prompt, which is answered with the video.
blocks.zh: 表5:三个步骤(测试集、准确度%)的缩小。 每个变体保留代理的计划,盒子和跟踪,并改变一步. 直接询问的音轨: 整个视频的编号片段带有基准问题,例如用跟踪器的ID进行视觉提示。 整个视频中的问题:没有位置。 以录像方式宣读的事实:同样的事实附在基准提示之后,用录像加以回答。

blocks.en: The principle has three parts. A static question binds the target to a track, it is asked about the evidence moment, and the answer is read from the tracks. Table 5 removes each part on the test sets, with the plan, the boxes and the tracks fixed.
blocks.zh: 该原则有三个部分。 一个静态问题将目标绑在轨道上,它被问到证据时刻,答案是从轨道上读来的. 表5删除了测试套件上的每个部分,并固定了计划,框和轨迹.

blocks.en: Binding. Without the bind question, the numbered tracks are drawn on the whole video and the benchmark question is asked directly, as in Coarse Correspondences [ 11 ] . The 8B model then answers 44.0%, 40.0% and 32.7% of the cup, card and real cup games, close to its direct answer. The 32B model reads the numbers better. It solves card monte and reaches 78.0% on the cup game. On the real cup games it stays at 40.2%, 12.1 points below the agent (CI [0.0, 24.3]).
blocks.zh: 装订。 没有捆绑问题,编号的音轨被绘制在整个视频上,基准问题被直接问到,如粗糙的信件[11]. 8B型随后回答44.0%,40.0%和32.7%的杯,卡和真杯游戏,接近其直接答案. 32B型更能读懂数字. 它能解决卡蒙特,并在杯赛上达到78.0%. 在真正的杯赛上,它停留在40.2%,低于代理商的12.1分(CI [0.0, 24.3]).

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Qualitative results (test videos, Qwen3-VL-8B unless noted). (a) A success that no method without binding reproduces. (b, c) The two most common failures on real cup games: a wrong viewpoint fact with correct tracks, and a tracker that loses identical cups crossed by hand. Numbered boxes are the agent’s tracks as the VLM sees them.
blocks.zh: 图3:定性结果(测试视频,Qwen3-VL-8B除外). (a) 没有约束性复制方法的成功。 (b,c) 真正的杯子游戏中最常见的两个失败:一个错误的视角事实和正确的音轨,以及一个失去手跨过同样杯子的跟踪器. VLM 所看到的编号的框是代理的轨迹 。

blocks.en: Evidence moment. Asking the bind question on the numbered clip of the whole video keeps both VET-Bench tasks at 100% at 8B. On the real cup games it gives 53.3%, 1.9 points above the agent (CI [ − 1.9 -1.9 , 5.6]). At 32B, card monte stays at 100% and the real cup games reach 54.2%, but the cup game drops to 72.0%. A located moment shortens the bind clip from about 47 to 12 frames on the cup game, and the 32B model needs the short clip there.
blocks.zh: 证据时刻。 询问整个视频中编号片段的绑定问题,使得VET-Bench的任务都保持在8B的100%. 在真正的杯赛上,它给予53.3%,比代理商高1.9分(CI[−1.9-1.9,5.6]). 在32B时,卡蒙特停留在100%,真正的杯赛达到54.2%,但杯赛降至72.0%. 一个定位的瞬间缩短了杯游戏的绑定片段从约47帧缩短到12帧,32B型需要在那里的短片段.

blocks.en: Text-only read-out. Appending the same facts to the benchmark prompt and answering with the video lowers accuracy on all three sets. At 8B the cup game drops from 100% to 38.0% and card monte to 72.0%. At 32B they drop to 76.0% and 96.0%. Reintroducing the shuffled video can reduce accuracy even when the tracked facts are unchanged.
blocks.zh: 仅文本读出. 将同样的事实输入基准即时并用录像回答,降低了所有三套的准确性。 8B时,杯赛从100%降至38.0%,卡蒙特降至72.0%. 在32B时下降到76.0%和96.0%。 重现被洗涤的视频即使跟踪的事实没有变化,也能降低准确性.

blocks.en: Table 6 : Bind clips selected by step 3 (test sets). Located : the VLM sees a 3 s clip around the evidence moment. Whole video : no moment is found, and the bind question is asked on the numbered clip of the whole video. No binding : the plan finds no target to tell apart, or fewer than two carrier tracks, and the question is answered with a timeline. Each cell gives the share of questions and, in parentheses, the accuracy on them. Frames: mean frames per bind call.
blocks.zh: 表6:按第3步(测试集)选择的带状剪辑。 定位:VLM在证据时刻看到3个片段。 整个录像:没有找到任何时间, 没有约束力 : 计划找不到分辨的目标, 或少于两个航母轨道, 这个问题用一个时间表来回答 。 每个单元格给出问题的比例,括号中给出问题的准确性。 框架:每个绑定呼叫的平均框架.

blocks.en: Bind clips. Table 6 shows which bind clip step 3 selects. On VET-Bench every question is bound on a located clip: 12 frames around the hiding of the ball, or 6 frames while the queen is face up. In real cup games the hidden object is small. Its own track yields a moment in only 21% (8B) and 11% (32B) of the videos. The other videos are bound on the whole numbered clip, about 60 frames over 15 s. They are answered more often than the located ones (55.0% against 40.9% at 8B). On real videos the gain therefore comes from the static question and the tracks, and a short window adds little. TOC-Bench questions concern visibility and events, so the plan almost never requests binding there. The gain on TOC-Bench comes from the timeline read-out.
blocks.zh: 剪辑 表6显示选择哪个夹片步骤3。 在VET-Bench上,每个问题都被绑在一个位置的片段上:12帧围绕球的隐藏,或者在王后面对时6帧. 在真正的杯子游戏中,隐藏对象很小. 它自己的音轨只产生21%(8B)和11%(32B)的视频. 其他的视频装在整段编号的片段上,大约60帧超过15秒. 答复的频率高于地点(55.0%,8B为40.9%)。 因此,在真实的视频中,收益来自静态问题和音轨,一个短窗口增加的不多。 TOC-Bench的问题涉及能见度和事件,因此该计划几乎从未要求在那里具有约束力. TOC-Bench的增益来自于时间表读取.

blocks.en: Table 7 : One configuration versus per-benchmark configurations (test sets): accuracy (%) and VLM calls per question.
blocks.zh: 表7:一个配置与每个基准的配置(测试集):准确性(%)和每题的VLM调用.

blocks.en: One configuration for all benchmarks. Table 7 compares the agent with three variants of itself, each tuned on one benchmark. They fix the bind question, the grounding frames, the tracking rate and the read-out per benchmark. For example, the card variant grounds 4 frames from the first 30% of each video and always tracks at 30 fps. On all four test sets the single configuration lies within the CI of the tuned variants. The single configuration issues 10.8 instead of 20.2 VLM calls per TOC-Bench question at 8B, and 13.4 instead of 20 per cup game.
blocks.zh: 所有基准都有一个配置。 表7比较了该剂本身的三个变体,每个变体都以一个基准调制. 他们固定了捆绑问题,搁浅框架,跟踪率和每个基准的读出. 例如,卡片变体将每段视频的前30%的4帧定位,并始终以30 fps的音轨. 在全部四个测试中,单一配置位于调制变体的CI内. 单曲配置发布10.8而不是20.2 VLM每TOC-Bench问题在8B,13.4而不是每杯比赛20场.

blocks.en: 5.4 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.4 定性分析

blocks.en: Success case. In the card-monte video of Fig. 3 (a), the queen is face up for one second. Every method that leaves the final judgement to the VLM answers that the queen stayed in the middle. SpatialClaw (32B) loses the queen’s mask once the card turns over and then guesses the middle (Fig. 4 ). Our agent asks which card is the queen only while it is face up. The tracks then carry the queen to the right.
blocks.zh: 成功的案例。 在Fig 3(a)的卡蒙视频中,王后正对一秒. 所有将最终判断权留给VLM的方法都回答女王留在中间. SpaceClaw(32B)一旦卡片翻转,然后猜测中间(图4)就会失去王后面具. 我们的经纪人问哪张牌是王后 只当面问 铁轨将王后抬到右边.

blocks.en: Failure cases. For each wrong answer on the real cup games, we check whether the gold option agrees with the bound track under either viewpoint. At 8B, 31 of the 52 errors agree with neither, so the binding or the tracking is wrong. In Fig. 3 (c), cups are lifted out of the frame and crossed by both hands, and the tracker loses them. Another 14 errors are explained by the viewpoint alone. In Fig. 3 (b) the bind and tracks are right, but the viewpoint fact mirrors the answer. The remaining errors are 5 questions that are never bound and 2 others. At 32B binding is more reliable. Of its 51 errors, 14 come from binding or tracking, 20 from the viewpoint, 12 from questions that are never bound, 3 from a read-out that ignores the facts, and 2 others.
blocks.zh: 失败案例。 对于真实的杯子游戏中的每一个错误的答案,我们检查黄金选项是否与两种观点下的绑定音轨一致. 8B时,52个错误中的31个都不同意,因此绑定或跟踪错误. 在图3(c)中,杯子被抬出框子,由两手交叉,追踪器失去. 另外14个错误仅用观点来解释。 在图3(b)中,绑定和轨迹是正确的,但观点反映了答案。 剩下的错误是5个永远没有约束的问题和另外两个问题. 在32B装订更可靠. 在51个错误中,14个来自约束或跟踪,20个来自观点,12个来自从未约束过的问题,3个来自无视事实的宣读,还有2个。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: The agent inherits the errors of its tracker. Identical cups that are lifted and crossed by hand still swap tracks, and very small hidden objects are rarely tracked. Most real cup games are therefore bound on the whole clip (Table 6 ). The agent issues about 11 VLM calls on every question, including general questions that need no tracking. A test that skips tracking for such questions is left to future work.
blocks.zh: 代理继承其跟踪器的错误. 手举起和跨越的相同杯子仍然互换轨道,非常小的隐藏物体很少被跟踪. 因此,大多数真实的杯子游戏被捆绑在整个片段(表6)上. 代理人发布大约11 VLM 的每个问题,包括不需要跟踪的一般性问题. 今后的工作要进行一个不跟踪这类问题的测试。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Video-LMs lose object identity when the identifying evidence disappears or the objects look alike. Track, Then Bind asks the VLM about identity once, about the moment the evidence is visible, keeps that identity with tracks, and answers from the tracked state in text. Without training, it solves both VET-Bench tasks and adds 17–18 points over direct answers on real cup games and, through track-derived timelines, 12–18 points on TOC-Bench.
blocks.zh: 当识别证据消失或物体看起来相似时,视频-LMs会失去对象身份. 轨迹 之后宾德曾向VLM询问身份,关于证据可见的时刻,保留该身份有轨迹,以及文字中来自跟踪状态的答案. 没有训练,它既解决了VET-Bench的任务,又在真正的杯赛上比直接回答增加了17–18分,并通过赛道衍生的时间安排,在TOC-Bench上增加了12–18分.

blocks.zh: 附录A 算法和执行细节

blocks.en: Development sets. The cup-game development set is the Perception Test validation question “Where is the hidden object at the end of the game from the person’s point of view?” on 195 of its 198 videos; three videos were unavailable. The card-monte development set consists of 56 videos rendered with the VET-Bench generator. We changed only the encoder, from H.264 to VP9 and back to H.264 at CRF 18, because headless Chromium has no H.264 encoder. Each video carries the test-set question about the Queen of Hearts, with the answer taken from the generator’s metadata. VET-Bench has no cup-game development set, so the cup game is tuned only through the real cup games and the card videos.
blocks.zh: 开发集. Cup-game的开发集是Perception测试验证问题, “从人物的角度看, 游戏结束时隐藏的对象在哪里? ” 在198个视频中的195个, 卡-蒙特开发集由56个视频组成,由VET-Bench生成器提供. 我们只把编码器从H.264改为VP9,在通用报告格式18中又改为H.264,因为无头铬没有H.264编码器。 每一段影片都包含关于"心之女王"的测试集问题,答案取自生成者的元数据. VET-Bench没有Cup-game开发设置,因此该杯游戏只能通过真实的Cup游戏和卡片视频调制.

blocks.en: TOC-Bench split. We use the released answer subset of TOC-Bench, 2,323 questions over 1,951 videos. Its videos are assigned at random (seed 20261017) to development (20%) and test (80%), so that the questions of one video stay in one split. The test split has 1,068 four-way multiple-choice questions, 447 two-statement questions, 241 numerical questions and 89 ordering questions. TOC-Bench scores each format with its own parser, and an unparsable answer counts as wrong.
blocks.zh: TOC - 奔驰分裂. 我们使用TOC-Bench的解答子集,2,323个问题超过1,951个视频. 它的视频被随机分配(种子20261017),用于开发(20%)和测试(80%),因此一个视频的问题会停留在一个分裂中. 试题分题有1068个四向多选题,447个双表题,241个数题和89个点题. TOC-Bench 使用自己的解析器对每个格式进行评分,一个无法解析的答案算作错误.

blocks.en: Disjointness. No video appears in two of the following sets: the cup-game development and test sets, the 2,000 general Perception Test questions, and the TOC-Bench development and test splits. The rendered card videos are new renders and share no file with the VET-Bench test videos.
blocks.zh: 离诸相. 以下两套没有出现视频:杯游戏开发与测试集,2000通用感知测试问题,TOC-Bench开发与测试分裂. 提供的卡片视频是新制作的,没有与VET-Bench测试视频共享文件.

blocks.en: Scoring and statistics. Perception Test and VET-Bench answers are parsed with the VET-Bench scorer, which reads the boxed letter. Every comparison in the paper is paired over the same questions. The confidence interval is the 2.5th and 97.5th percentile of 10,000 bootstrap resamples of the questions (seed 0). The p p -value is the exact two-sided McNemar test on the questions that exactly one of the two methods answers correctly.
blocks.zh: 分数与统计. 感知测试和VET-Bench的答案用VET-Bench的计分器解析,该计分器读取了盒式字母. 论文中的每一个比较都与同样的问题成对。 置信间隔为10 000个问题(种子0)的靴带复标值的2.5和97.5百分位数。 p-值是两种方法中确切一种正确回答的问题上准确的双面麦克尼玛测试.

blocks.en: VideoAgent. We run the official code (commit 42e1b70) with its prompts, tools and memory construction. The memory holds LaViLa captions of 2 s segments, ViCLIP segment features, RT-DETR-L tracks from ByteTrack at 15 fps, and CLIP and DINOv2 features for re-identification. Video-LLaVA-7B answers its visual questions. Four parts need a closed API or the network, and we replace them. Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct at temperature 0 takes the place of GPT-4 as the agent LLM. The OpenAI text embedding is replaced by all-mpnet-base-v2, a sentence model that the official encoder already offers. LangChain’s prompt download is replaced by the same template held locally, and an unused caption-metric import by a stub. The official multiple-choice prompt fixes five choices, so it states the actual number of choices. LangChain returns format errors in the ReAct output to the agent instead of stopping (handle_parsing_errors). TOC-Bench ordering questions go to the official free-form runner. A question takes 9.8 LLM calls and 9.0k LLM input tokens on average. Eleven of the 2,052 questions end with a malformed tool input and count as wrong.
blocks.zh: 视频代理. 我们运行官方代码(承诺42e1b70),带有它的提示,工具和记忆构造. 内存持有2s段的LaViLa字幕,VICLIP段功能,15fps的ByteTrack的RT-DETR-L音轨,以及用于重新识别的CLIP和DINOv2功能. Video-LLaVA-7B解答其视觉问题. 四部分需要关闭的API或网络,我们来替换它们. 0温度下的Qune3-VL-32B-Instruct取代GPT-4作为剂LLM. OpenAI文本嵌入被All-mpnet-base-v2取代,这是官方编码器已经提供的句子模型. LangChain 的即时下载被本地持有的同一模板所取代, 官方的多选择即时修正了五个选择,因此它说明了选择的实际数量. LangChain 将 ReAct 输出中的格式错误返回代理器而不是停止( handle_parsing_errors) 。 TOC -Bench命令问问题 交给官方的自由式跑者 一个问题平均需要9.8LLM调用和9.0kLLM输入符. 2,052个问题中有11个以错误的工具输入结束,算错.

blocks.en: VideoINSTA. We run the official code (publication branch) with the authors’ NExT-QA configuration. It samples one frame per second and splits the video into four event clips by clustering CLIP ViT-L/14 features. CogAgent describes the actions and objects of each clip, and UniVTG locates the spans that match the question. The LLM summarises each clip, rates how well it answers the question, and merges the ratings into an answer. Three changes are needed. Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct at temperature 0 takes the place of GPT-3.5 as the LLM. The authors release CogAgent captions and object lists only for their own benchmarks, so we compute them with their extraction configuration. The prompts state the actual number of choices instead of five, and ordering questions use the authors’ free-form prompts. A question takes 14.8 LLM calls and 11.2k LLM input tokens on average, measured from the server logs. One answer names a choice that the question does not have and counts as wrong.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2017-09-21). VideoINSTA. 我们用作者的NExT-QA配置来运行官方代码(出版分支). 它通过集成CLIP ViT-L/14特性,对每秒一个帧进行取样,并将视频分成四个事件片段. CogAgent描述每个剪辑的动作和对象,UniVTG定位与问题匹配的跨度. LLM对每个片段进行总结,评分它回答问题的程度如何,并将收视率合并为一个答案. 需要进行三项改革。 0温度下的Quen3-VL-32B-指令取代了GBT-3.5作为LLM. 作者发布 CogAgent 标题和对象列表只针对他们自己的基准,所以我们用他们的提取配置来计算它们. 提示注明了实际选择数而不是五个, 一个问题需要14.8LLM调用和平均11.2kLLM输入符,从服务器日志中测量. 一个回答名字是问题没有的选择,并算作错误。
